text.body: <1> bhāradvāja śrautasūtram atha prathamaḥ praśnaḥ darśapūrṇamāsau vyākhyāsyāmaḥ 1 āmāvāsyena haviṣā yakṣyamāṇa ekasyā dvayorvā pūrvedyurhavirātañcanaṃ dohayati 2 api vā purastādeva dvyahe tryahe vānuguptaṃ dugdhaṃ dohayitvānuguptena dadhnātanakti 3 saṃtatamavicchinnamabhiduhantyopavasathāt 4 yadahaḥ pūrṇaścandra māḥ syāt tāṃ paurṇamāsīmupavaset 5 śvaḥ pūriteti vā 6 yadaharna dṛśyeta tāmamāvāsyām 7 śvo nodeteti vā 8 tatraiṣo'tyantapradeśo ye kecana paurṇamāsīmamāvāsyāṃ vā dharmā anārabhyāmnāyanta ubhayatraiva te kriyante 9 yajñopavītyeva daiveṣu karmasu bhavati 10 prācīnāvītī pitryeṣu 11 prāṅnyāyānyudaṅnyāyāni vā pradakṣiṇaṃ daivāni karmāṇi kuryāt 12 viparītaṃ pitryāṇi 13 na vihārādapaparyāvarteta 14 na yajñāṅgenātmānamabhipariharedanyaṃ vā 15 uttarataupacāro vihāraḥ 16 yatra kva ca juhotīti codayedadhvaryureva juhvājyenāhavanīye juhuyāt 17 adhvaryumevānādiṣṭe kartari pratīyādāgnīdhraṃ dvitīyam 18 yatra kva copatiṣṭhate'numantrayata iti codayed yajamāna eva tat kuryāt 19 ekamantrāṇi karmāṇi 20 ādipradiṣṭā mantrā bhavanti 21 1.1 uttarasyādinā pūrvasyāvasānam 1 mantrāntaiḥ karmādīn saṃnipātayet 2 atha yatra hrasvo mantraḥ syād dīrghaṃ karma karmādau mantraṃ japet 3 atha yatra dvābhyāṃ juhoti pañcabhirjuhotīti codayet pratimantraṃ tatrāhutīrjuhuyāt 4 atha yatra yajñāṅge karmābhyāvartayenna mantro'bhyāvarteta 5 jvalatyeva sarvā āhutīrjuhuyāt 6 vratamupaiṣyati śākhāmacchaiti 7 palāśaśākhām̐ śamīśākhāṃ vā 8 sā yā prācyudīcī prācī vodīcī vā bahuparṇā bahuśākhāpratiśuṣkāgrāsuṣirā tāmāchinatti iṣe tvā iti 9 ūrje tvā iti saṃnamayatyanumārṣṭi vā 10 athaināmāharati imāṃ prācīmudīcīmiṣamūrjamabhisam̐ skṛtām | bahuparṇāmaśuṣkāgrām̐ harāmi paśupāmaham || iti 11 tayā ṣaḍavarārdhyān vatsānapākaroti vāyava sthopāyava stha iti 12 yāvatīnāmekā kumbhī dugdham̐ saṃbharet tāvatī parārdhyā mātrā syāt 13 ekam̐ śākhayopaspṛśati 14 tayaiva gāḥ prasthāpayati devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa ā pyāyadhvamaghniyā indrā ya devabhāgamiti 15 mahendrā ya iti vā yadi mahendra yājī bhavati 16 ekām̐ śākhayopaspṛśati 17 prasthitā anumantrayate śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ śatamindrā ya śarado duhānāḥ | rudra sya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu || iti 18 mahendrā ya iti vā yadi mahendra yājī bhavati 19 1.2 dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīḥ iti yajamānasya gṛhānabhiparyāvartate 1 agniṣṭhe'nasyagnyagāre vā purastātpratīcīm̐ śākhāmupagūhati yajamānasya paśūn pāhi iti 2 paścātprācīmityekeṣām 3 yo vā adhvaryorgṛhān veda gṛhavān bhavati | ā caturthāt karmaṇo'bhisamīkṣetedaṃ kariṣyāmīdaṃ kariṣyāmīti | ete vā adhvaryorgṛhāḥ | ya evaṃ veda gṛhavān bhavatīti vijñāyate 4 sāvitreṇāśvaparśumanaḍutparśumasidaṃ vādāya gārhapatyamabhimantrayate yajñasya ghoṣadasi iti 5 pratyuṣṭam̐ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātayaḥ ityāhavanīye dātraṃ pratitapati 6 preyamagāddhiṣaṇā barhiraccha iti prāṅ vodaṅ vābhipravrajya yataḥ kutaśca darbhamayaṃ barhirāharati 7 viṣṇo stūpo'si iti prathamam̐ stambamutsṛjati 8 dvitīyaṃ pariṣauti devānāṃ pariṣūtamasi varṣavṛddhamasi iti 9 tasya dve tisro vā nāḍīrutsṛjati avaśiṣṭo gavāṃ bhāgaḥ iti 10 stambamārabhate devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ barhirdevasadanamārabhe iti 11 parvaṇi dāti devabarhirmā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak parva te rādhyāsamāchettā te mā riṣam iti 12 saṃnakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ lunoti 13 sa prastaro bhavati 14 kulmimātra ityekeṣām 15 ūrvasthimātra ityekeṣām 16 srugdaṇḍamātra ityekeṣām 17 aparimita ityekeṣām 18 evamevāyujo muṣṭīṃllunoti 19 yadanyat pariṣavaṇādutsarjanāditi sarvaṃ tat karoti 20 prastaro yuktamityekeṣāmayuktamityekeṣām 21 ayuñji nidhanāni lunotītyekeṣām 22 1.3 devabarhiḥ śatavalśaṃ viroha ityālavān pratyabhimṛśati 1 sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema ityātmānam 2 athainat saṃbharati pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi susaṃbhṛtā tvā saṃbharāmi iti 3 ata eva barhiṣaḥ śulbaṃ karoti tridhātu pañcadhātu vā 4 ayupito yoniḥ iti śulbamāveṣṭayati 5 adityai rāsnāsi iti pratidadhāti 6 tatraiṣo'tyantapradeśo yāni kāni ca śulbāni na samasyante pradakṣiṇaṃ tānyāveṣṭayet 7 atha yāni samasyante prasavyaṃ teṣāṃ guṇamāveṣṭya pradakṣiṇamabhisamasyet 8 udagagram̐ śulbaṃ nidhāya tasmin prāgagraṃ barhirnidadhāti 9 alubhito yoniḥ ityuttame nidhane prastaramatyādadhāti 10 athainat saṃnahyati indrāṇyai saṃnahanam iti 11 pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātu iti granthiṃ karoti 12 sa te mā syāt iti paścātprāñcamupagūhati 13 purastātpratyañcamityekeṣām 14 athainadārabhate āpastvāmaśvinau tvāmṛṣayaḥ sapta māmṛjuḥ | barhiḥ sūryasya raśmibhiruṣasāṃ ketumārabhe || iti 15 udyacchate indrasya tvā bāhubhyāmudyacche iti 16 śīrṣannadhinidhatte bṛhaspatermūrdhnā harāmi iti 17 āharati urvantarikṣamanvihi iti 18 apareṇāhavanīyaṃ paridhīnāṃ kāle'ntarvedyanadhaḥ sādayati adityāstvopasthe sādayāmi iti 19 devaṃgamamasi ityāsannamabhimantrayate 20 uparīva prajñātaṃ nidadhāti 21 1.4 yā jātā oṣadhayo devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | tāsāṃ parva rādhyāsaṃ paristaramāharan || apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam̐ sadevam̐ śivamastu me | āchettā vo mā riṣaṃ jīvāni śaradaḥ śatam || aparimitānāṃ parimitāḥ saṃnahye sukṛtāya kam | eno mā nigāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ punarutthāya bahulā bhavantu || iti paristaraṇānāṃ darbhāṇāmadhinidhānyāchedanī saṃnahanītyetā āmnātā bhavanti 1 ekavim̐ śatidārumidhmaṃ karoti pālāśaṃ khādiraṃ vā 2 aṣṭādaśadārumidhmam̐ saṃnahyatītyekeṣām 3 pañcadaśa sāmidhenīdārūṇi bhavanti 4 trayaḥ paridhayaḥ 5 pālāśāḥ kārṣmaryamayā vā śuṣkā vārdrā vā savalkalāḥ 6 atho khādirā bailvā audumbarā vaikaṅkatā rauhitakā veti vijñāyate 7 sthaviṣṭho madhyamo'ṇīyān drāghīyān dakṣiṇārdhyo'ṇiṣṭho hvasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ 8 dve āghārasamidhau 9 anūyājasamidekavim̐ śī 10 samūlānāmamūlānāṃ vā darbhāṇāmayugdhātu tathaiva śulbaṃ karoti 11 tasminnidhmam̐ saṃbharati 12 yat kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā prāviśastvaṃ vanaspatīn | tatastvāmekavim̐ śatidhā saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā || trīn paridhīm̐stisraḥ samidho yajñāyuranusaṃcarān | upaveṣaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ dhṛṣṭim̐ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā || iti saṃnahyati 13 kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhaḥ || deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tvā iti purastātpratyañcaṃ granthimupagūhati 14 athainamanadhaḥ sādayitvā prajñātānīdhmapravraścanāni nidadhāti 15 1.5 śvo bhūta idhmābarhiṣī vratopete paurṇamāsyāṃ kuryāt 1 pūrvedyurevāmāvāsyāyām 2 yāthākāmī paurṇamāsyāmityaparam 3 darbhamayaṃ vedaṃ karoti vedo'si yena tvaṃ deva veda devebhyo vedo'bhavastena mahyaṃ vedo bhūyāḥ iti 4 vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya mūtakāryamannādyakāmasya trivṛtaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya | trivṛcchirasaṃ bruvate 5 nityavat pūrvau kalpāveke samāmananti 6 athainaṃ prādeśamātre parivāsayati 7 śulbāt prādeśamātra ityekeṣām 8 prajñātāni vedāgrāṇi nidhāya yayā śākhayā vatsānapākaroti tasyā antarvedi palāśānāmekadeśaṃ praśātayati 9 mūlataḥ śākhāṃ parivāsya tamupaveṣaṃ karoti upaveṣo'si yajñāya tvāṃ pariveṣamadhārayan | indrāya haviḥ kṛṇvantaḥ śivaḥ śagmo bhavāsi naḥ iti 10 athāsyā darbhamayaṃ prādeśamātraṃ pavitraṃ karoti trivṛdavalayaṃ vasūnāṃ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasūnāṃ pavitramasi sahasradhāram iti 11 mūle mūlamavasajatyagre'gram | na granthiṃ karoti 12 kriyamāṇaṃ yajamāno'numantrayate trivṛtpalāśe darbha iyān prādeśasaṃmitaḥ | yajñe pavitraṃ potṛtamaṃ payo havyaṃ karotu me || iti 13 parisamūhantyagnyagārāṇyupalimpantyāyatanāni 14 yāvaccharkaram̐ sāṃnāyyakumbhyau gomayenopalipte bhavataḥ 15 alaṃkurvāte yajamānaḥ patnī ca 16 1.6 amāvāsyāyāmadhivṛkṣasūrye piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti 1 dakṣiṇāprāgagrairdarbhairanvāhāryapacanaṃ paristīryaikaikaśaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñapātrāṇi prakṣālya prayunakti sphyam̐ sruvamājyasthālīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalaṃ musalam̐ śūrpaṃ yena cārthī bhavati 2 adhvaryuryajñopavītī dakṣiṇataḥ śakaṭādekapavitre'dhi sthālyāṃ nirvapati 3 pūrayitvā nimārṣṭi 4 kṛṣṇājina ulūkhalaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dakṣiṇāprācī patnī tiṣṭhantī parāpāvamavivekamavahanti 5 sakṛt phalīkaroti 6 dakṣiṇāgnau jīvataṇḍulamiva śrapayitvotpūtena navanītenābhighārayatyanutpūtena vā sarpiṣā 7 dakṣiṇapūrveṇānvāhāryapacanamuttarāpareṇa vā dakṣiṇāprācīmekasphyāṃ vedimuddhatyāvokṣya sakṛdācchinnena barhiṣā stṛṇāti sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhirūrṇāmṛdu syonaṃ pitṛbhyastvā bharāmyaham | asmin sīdantu me pitaraḥ somyāḥ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāścānugaiḥ saha || iti 8 tasyāmetam̐ sthālīpākaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dakṣiṇataḥ kaśipūpabarhaṇamāñjanamabhyañjanamityekaikaśa āsādya 9 1.7 adhvaryuryajñopavītī dakṣiṇaṃ jānvācya mekṣaṇena sthālīpākasyopahatyābhighārya juhoti | somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā namaḥ iti prathamām 1 yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ iti dvitīyām 2 ye mekṣaṇe taṇḍulāstān agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namaḥ iti tṛtīyām 3 tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇamādadhāti 4 dakṣiṇāgnerekolmuktaṃ nirūhati ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānā asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti | parāpuro nipuro ye harantyagniṣṭāṃllokāt praṇudātvasmāt iti 5 yajamānaḥ savyaṃ jānvācya prācīnāvītī trīnudakāñjalīnekasphyāyāmupaninayati asāvavaneniṅkṣva iti pitaram asāvavaneniṅkṣva iti pitāmaham asāvavaneniṅkṣva prapitāmaham 6 atraiva nāmādeśamavācīnapāṇirdakṣiṇāpavargāsm̐trīn piṇḍān nidadhāti etatte tata ye ca tvāmanu ityetairmantraiḥ 7 atha yadi dvipitā syāt pratipūruṣaṃ piṇḍān dadyāt 8 api vaikaikasmin piṇḍe dvaudvāvupalakṣayet 9 atha yadi jīvapitā syāt pitāmahāya prapitāmahāya ca dadyāt 10 na jīvantamatidadātītyekeṣām 11 homāntameva kurvīta 12 1.8 atha yadi bandhunāma na viditaṃ svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthivīṣadbhyaḥ iti prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | svadhā pitṛbhyo'ntarikṣasadbhyaḥ iti dvitīyam̐ svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyaḥ iti tṛtīyam 1 tūṣṇīṃ caturthaṃ piṇḍaṃ nidhāya atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam ityuktvā parāṅāvartate 2 oṣmaṇo vyāvṛta upāste 3 vyāvṛtta ūṣmaṇyabhiparyāvartate'vyāvṛtte vā amīmadanta pitaraḥ somyāḥ iti 4 abhiparyāvṛtya yaḥ sthālyām̐ śeṣastamavajighrati vīraṃ dhatta pitaraḥ iti 5 āmayāvinā prāśyo'nnādyakāmena prāśyo yo'lamannādyāya sannannaṃ nādyāt tena prāśya iti vijñāyate 6 tathaivodakāñjalīnupaninīyāñjanābhyañjane dadāti āṅkṣvāsau || abhyaṅkṣvāsau iti triranupiṇḍam 7 etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsām̐ syato no'nyat pitaro mā yoṣṭa iti loma chittvopanyasyati vāsaso vā daśām 8 uttara āyuṣi loma chindīta 9 chittvā namaskārairupatiṣṭhate namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya iti pratipadya ahaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭho bhūyāsam ityantena 10 atha pitṝnutthāpayati uttiṣṭhata pitaraḥ preta śūrā yamasya panthāmanuvetā purāṇam | dhattādasmāsu dra viṇaṃ yacca bhadraṃ pra ṇo brūtād bhāgadhān devatāsu iti 11 pitṝn pravāhayati pareta pitaraḥ somyāḥ ityetayā 12 manasvatībhirupatiṣṭhate mano nvā huvāmahe iti tisṛbhiḥ 13 1.9 ulmukamapisṛjati abhūnno dūto haviṣo jātavedā avāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā | prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣan prajānannagne punarapyehi devān iti 1 prājāpatyayarcā punareti prajāpate ityetayā 2 paṅktyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate yadantarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmuta dyām iti 3 agnau sakṛdāchinnaṃ prahṛtyādbhiḥ prokṣya dvandvaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñapātrāṇi pratyudāharati 4 apaḥ piṇḍānabhyavaharedbrāhmaṇaṃ vā bhojayedagnau vā praharet 5 ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye | teṣām̐ lokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām iti prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ praharati 6 ye sajātāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣām̐ śrīrmayi kalpatāmasmiṃlloke śatam̐ samāḥ itītarau 7 patnī vā madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ prāśnāti 8 pumām̐ sam̐ ha jānukā bhavatīti vijñāyate 9 ādhatta pitaro garbhaṃ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam | yatheha pitaro loke dīrghamāyuḥ prajīvitāt iti prāśana āmnāto bhavati 10 saṃtiṣṭhate piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ 11 evaṃvihita evānāhitāgnerbhavatyanyatra gārhapatyopasthānāt 12 anyaṃ gārhapatyasthānīyamāgamayedityekam 13 yasmin praharet tamupatiṣṭhetetyaparam 14 tatra gārhapatyaśabdo lupyeta sam̐ skārapratiṣedhāt 15 1.10 tataḥ saṃpreṣyati paristṛṇīta paridhattāgniṃ parihito'gniryajamānaṃ bhunaktu | apām̐ rasa oṣadhīnām̐ suvarṇo niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmiṃlloke iti 1 tato'gnīn paristṛṇāti pūrvāścām̐ parau ca prāgagrairdarbhaiḥ 2 api vodagagrāḥ paścāt purastācca bhavanti 3 dakṣiṇāḥ pakṣa upariṣṭād bhavatyadhastāduttaraḥ 4 dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ brahmayajamānayorāyatane kalpayati 5 pūrvaṃ brahmaṇo'paraṃ yajamānasya 6 svayaṃ yajamānaḥ parvaṇyagnihotraṃ juhoti 7 nāsyāmāvāsyām̐ rātriṃ kumārā api payaḥ pibanti 8 yavāgvāsyaitām̐ rātrimagnihotram̐ hutvāgnihotroccheṣaṇam̐ havirātañcanaṃ nidadhāti 9 sāṃnāyyapātrāṇi prakṣālya dvandvaṃ prayunakti 10 uttareṇa gārhapatyaṃ kumbhīṃ dohanam̐ śākhāpavitramupaveṣamabhidhānīṃ nidāne yena cārthī bhavati 11 agnihotrahavaṇyāṃ tiraḥ pavitramapa ānīyodagagrābhyāṃ trirutpunāti devo vaḥ savitotpunātu iti paccho gāyatryā 12 athainā abhimantrayate āpo devīragrepuvaḥ iti pratipadya prokṣitā sthā ityantena 13 sāṃnāyyapātrāṇi prokṣatyuttānāni paryāvṛtya 14 1.11 śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyai iti triḥ 1 athaitāni niṣṭapati niṣṭaptam̐ rakṣo niṣṭapto'ghaśam̐ saḥ iti 2 atha gā āyatīḥ pratīkṣate etā ācaranti madhumad duhānāḥ prajāvatīryaśaso viśvarūpāḥ | bahvīrbhavantīrupajāyamānā iha va indro ramayatu gāvaḥ iti 3 adityai rāsnāsi ityabhidhānīmādāya pūṣāsi iti vatsamabhidadhāti | pūṣā stha iti vā sarvān 4 tata āha upasṛṣṭāṃ me prabrūtāt iti 5 upasṛṣṭāmanumantrayate ayakṣmā vaḥ prajayā sam̐ sṛjāmi rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīḥ iti 6 upasīdantamanumantrayate ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca jīvo jīvantīrupa vaḥ sadeyam iti 7 tataḥ saṃpreṣyati vihāraṃ gāṃ copasṛṣṭāmantareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭa iti 8 na duhyamānāmantareṇa saṃcaranti vihāraṃ ca 9 yadi vyaveyāt sāṃnāyyaṃ mā vilopi iti brūyāt 10 dhṛṣṭirasi brahma yaccha ityupaveṣamādāya gārhapatyādudīco'ṅgārān nirūhati nirūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam iti 11 teṣu kumbhīmadhiśrayati mātariśvano gharmo'si iti 12 athaināṃ pradakṣiṇamaṅgāraiḥ paryūhati bhṛgūṇāmaṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasva iti 13 athāsyām̐ śākhāpavitraṃ prāgagraṃ nidadhāti vasūnāṃ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasūnāṃ pavitramasi sahasradhāram iti 14 1.12 sapavitrāṃ kumbhīmanvārabhya vācaṃ yacchati 1 dhārayannāste 2 dhārāghoṣamabhimantrayate utsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilamiḍāṃ devīṃ madhumatīm̐ suvarvidam | tadindrā gnī jinvatam̐ sūnṛtāvat tadyajamānamamṛtatve dadhātu iti 3 duhyamāne vratānāṃ vratapate ityāhavanīyam 2 antato devatā upatiṣṭhate devā deveṣu parākramadhvaṃ prathamā dvitīyeṣu dvitīyāstṛtīyeṣu | trirekādaśā iha māvata | idam̐ śakeyaṃ yadidaṃ karomi | ātmā karotvātmane | idaṃ kariṣye bheṣajamidaṃ me viśvabheṣajā | aśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam iti 3 vratamupayan samudraṃ manasā dhyāyati 4 sa etad vrataṃ caratina mām̐ samaśnāti na striyamupaiti noparyāste jugupsate'nṛtādanāśvānetām̐ rātrimupavasatyapo vāśnātyāraṇyaṃ vā | kāmamāraṇyasyāśnīyāt 5 ā mārgādā madhuna ā prāśātikādityekeṣām 6 āraṇyāyopavasannapo vāśnīyānna vā kiṃcana 7 āmāvāsyām̐ rātriṃ jāgarti 8 api vā yathā śaknuyāt tathā kuryāt 9 upari tveva na śayīta 10 kāmamupari śayīta 11 vratacārī tveva syāt 12 4.4 āhavanīyāgāre gārhapatyāgāre vā saṃviśati 1 śvo bhūte'pareṇāhavanīyamatikramyāpareṇa brahmasadanaṃ yajamāna āhavanīyamabhimukha upaviśati 2 so'traivāsīnaḥ karmāṇi kriyamāṇānyabhimantrayate 3 agnīn paristīryamāṇānabhimantrayate ubhāvagnī upastṛṇate devatā upavasantu me | ahaṃ grāmyānupavasāmi mahyaṃ gopataye paśūn || iti 4 praṇītāḥ praṇīyamānā abhimantrayate bhūśca kaśca vāk cark ca gauśca vaṭ ca khaṃ ca dhūśca nūśca pūśca || ekākṣarāḥ pūrdaśamā virājo yā idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vyānaśuḥ | tā no devīstarasā saṃvidānāḥ svasti yajñaṃ nayata prajānatīḥ || brahmapūtāḥ stha || ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu viśvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo devayajyāyai || yāḥ purastāt prasravantyupariṣṭāt sarvataśca yāḥ | tābhī raśmipavitrābhiḥ śraddhāṃ yajñamārabhe || iti 5 4.5 havirnirupyamāṇamabhimantrayate agnim̐ hotāramiha tam̐ huve iti 1 taduditvā vācaṃ yacchatyā haviṣkṛtaḥ 2 sarvaṃ vihāramabhimantrayate kastvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktu iti 3 vedim̐ saṃmṛjyamānāmabhimantrayate catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye | marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya mahyaṃ dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān || iti 4 stambayajurhviyamāṇamabhimantrayate yo mā hṛdā manasā yaśca vācā yo brahmaṇā karmaṇā dveṣṭi devāḥ | yaḥ śrutena hṛdayeneṣṇatā ca tasyendra vajreṇa śiraśchinadmi || iti 5 utkaramabhigṛhyamāṇamabhimantrayate idaṃ tasmai harmyaṃ karomi yo vo devāścarati brahmacaryam | medhāvī dikṣu manasā tapasvyantardūtaścarati mānuṣīṣu || iti 6 parigrāhaṃ pūrvaṃ cottaraṃ cābhimantrayate yajñasya tvā pramayābhimayā pratimayonmayā parigṛhṇāmi || bṛhaspate pari gṛhāṇa vedim̐ svagā vo devāḥ sadanāni santu | tasyāṃ barhiḥ prathatām̐ sādhvantarahim̐ srā ṇaḥ pṛthivī devyastu || iti 7 4.6 tvacamuddhanyamānāmabhimantrayate yadudghnanto jihiṃmsima pṛthivīmoṣadhīrapaḥ | adhvaryavaḥ sphyakṛtaḥ sphyenāntarikṣaṃ moru pātu tasmāt || yadudghnanto jihim̐ sima krūramasyā vediṃ cakṛmā manasā devayantaḥ | mā tena heḍa upagāma bhūmyāḥ śivā no viśvairbhuvanebhirastu || iti 1 kṛtāmanumantrayate bhūmirbhūtvā mahimānaṃ pupoṣa tato devī vardhayate payām̐ si | yajñiyā yajñaṃ vi ca yanti śaṃ cauṣadhīrāpa iha śakvarīśca || iti 2 prokṣaṇīrāsādyamānā abhimantrayate īḍenyakratūrahamapo devīrupabruve | divā naktaṃ ca sasruṣīrapasvarīḥ || iti 3 barhirupasādyamānamabhimantrayate aśiśrema barhirantaḥ pṛthivyām̐ sam̐ rohayanta oṣadhīrvivṛkṇāḥ | yāsāṃ mūlamudavadhīḥ sphyena śivā nastāḥ suhavā bhavantu || iti 4 ājyaṃ prokṣaṇīścotpūyamānā abhimantrayate adbhirājyamājyenāpaḥ samyak punīta savituḥ pavitraiḥ | tā devīḥ śakvarīḥ śākvareṇemaṃ yajñamavata saṃvidānāḥ || iti 5 vyākhyātamājyāvekṣaṇamājyagrahā iti 6 4.7 antarvedi barhirāsādyamānamabhimantrayate sumanaso yajamānāya santvoṣadhīrāpa iha śakvarīśca | vṛṣṭidyāvā parjanya enā virohayatu hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śatavalśā adabdhāḥ || iti 1 barhiḥ stīryamāṇamabhimantrayate ūrṇāmṛdu prathamānam̐ syonaṃ devebhyo juṣṭam̐ sadanāya barhiḥ | suvarge loke yajamānam̐ hi dhehi māṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe parame vyoman || iti 2 vedim̐ sam̐ stīryamāṇāmabhimantrayate catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste | sā stīryamāṇā mahate saubhagāya sā me dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān || śivā ca me śagmā caidhi | syonā ca me suṣadā caidhi | ūrjasvatī ca me payasvatī caidhi || iṣamūrjaṃ me pinvasva | brahma tejo me pinvasva | kṣatramojo me pinvasva | viśaṃ puṣṭiṃ me pinvasva | āyurannādyaṃ me pinvasva | prajāṃ paśūn me pinvasva | lokaṃ me pinvasva iti 3 4.8 paridhīn paridhīyamānānabhimantrayate dhruvo'si dhruvo'ham̐ sajāteṣu bhūyāsam ityetaiḥ pratimantram | asmin yajña upa bhūya innu me'vikṣobhāya paridhīn dadhāmi | dhartā dharuṇo dharīyānagnirdveṣām̐ si nirito nudātai || iti ca sarvān 1 āhavanīyamabhimantrayate yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena havyāyāsmai voḍhave jātavedaḥ | indhānāstvā suprajasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvema balihṛto vayaṃ te || yanme agne asya yajñasya riṣyādyadvā skandādājyasyota viṣṇo | tena hanmi sapatnaṃ durmarāyumainaṃ dadhāmi nirṛtyā upasthe || tejiṣṭhā te tapanā yā ca rocanā pratyopantīstanvo yāste agne | tābhirvarmāṇyabhito vyayasva mā tvā dabhan yajñahanaḥ piśācāḥ || iti 2 vidhṛtī nidhīyamāne abhimantrayate vicchinadmi vidhṛtībhyām̐ sapatnān jātān bhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ | viśo yantrābhyāṃ vidhamāmyenānaham̐ svānāmuttamo'sāni devāḥ || viśo yantre nudamāne arātiṃ viśvaṃ pāpmānamamatiṃ durmarāyum | sīdantī devī sukṛtasya loke prajāmasmabhyaṃ dra viṇaṃ ca dhattam || dhṛtī stho vidhṛtī svadhṛtī prāṇān mayi dhārayataṃ prajāṃ mayi dhārayataṃ paśūn mayi dhārayatam iti 3 prastaram̐ sādyamānamabhimantrayate ayaṃ prastara ubhayasya dhartā dhartā prayājānāmutānūyājānām | sa dādhāra samidho viśvarūpāstasmin sruco adhyāsādayāmi || iti 4 4.9 srucaḥ sādyamānā abhimantrayate āroha patho juhu devayānān yatrarṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ | hiraṇyapakṣājirā saṃbhṛtāṅgā vahāsi mā sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ || juhūrasi ghṛtācī gāyatrīyāmnī kavibhirjuṣāṇā | avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devānāgneyena śarmaṇā daivyena || iti juhūm 1 avāhaṃ bādha upabhṛtā sapatnān jātān bhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ | dohai yajñam̐ sudughāmiva dhenumahamuttaro bhūyāsamadhare matsapatnāḥ || subhṛdasyupabhṛd ghṛtācī traiṣṭubhena chandasā viśvavedaḥ | avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devānaindre ṇa śarmaṇā daivyena || ityupabhṛtam 2 yo mā vācā manasā durmarāyurhṛdārātīyādabhidāsadagne | idamasya cittamadharaṃ dhruvāyā ahamuttaro bhūyāsamadhare matsapatnāḥ || dhruvāsi dharaṇī dhanasya pūrṇā jāgatena chandasā viśvavedaḥ | avyathamānā yajñamanuyacchasva sunītī yajñaṃ nayāsyupa devān vaiśvadevena śarmaṇā daivyena || iti dhruvām 3 4.10 syono me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyāṃ prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke | divi sīda pṛthivyāmantarikṣe'hamuttaro bhūyāsamadhare matsapatnāḥ || ayam̐ sruvo abhijiharti homān śatakṣaraśchandasānuṣṭubhena | sarvā yajñasya samanakti viṣṭhā bārhaspatyena śarmaṇā daivyena || iti sruvam 1 iyam̐ sthālī ghṛtasya pūrṇācchinnapayāḥ śatadhāra utsaḥ | mārutena śarmaṇā daivyena || ityājyasthālīm 2 puroḍāśāvajyamānāvabhimantrayate tṛptirasi gāyatraṃ chandastarpaya mā tejasā brahmavarcasena || tṛptirasi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandastarpaya maujasā vīryeṇa || tṛptirasi jāgataṃ chandastarpaya mā prajayā paśubhiḥ || iti 3 antarvedi havīm̐ ṣyāsannānyabhimṛśati yajño'si sarvataḥ śritaḥ sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatām | śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtā irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ || ityāgneyaṃ puroḍāśam | prajāpatirasi sarvataḥ śritaḥ sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatām | śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtā irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ || ityagnīṣomīyam | yo naḥ kanīya iha kāmayātā asmin yajñe yajamānāya mahyam | apa tamindrā gnī bhuvanānnudetāmahaṃ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ videya || ityaindrā gnam 4 4.11 idamindri yamamṛtaṃ vīryamanenendrā ya paśavo'cikitsan | tena devā avatopa māmiheṣamūrjaṃ yaśaḥ saha ojaḥ saneyam̐ śṛtaṃ mayi śrayatām || iti śṛtam 1 yat pṛthivīmacarattat praviṣṭaṃ yenāsiñcadbalamindre prajāpatiḥ | idaṃ tacchukraṃ madhu vājinīvadyenopariṣṭādadhinonmahendra m || dadhi māṃ dhinotu || iti dadhi 2 sarvāṇi samastānyabhimṛśati mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu ityetenānuvākena | ayaṃ yajñaḥ samasadaddhaviṣmānṛcā sāmnā yajuṣā devatābhiḥ | tena lokān sūryavato jayemendra sya sakhyamamṛtatvamaśyām || iti ca 3 sāmidhenīranūcyamānā abhimantrayate aṅgiraso māsya yajñasya prātaranuvākairavantu iti 4 yāṃ yāmāśiṣaṃ kāmayate tāmāśāste 5 yatrābhijānāti samiddho agna āhutaḥ iti tadāhavanīyamabhimantrayate samiddho agnirāhuta svāhākṛtaḥ pipartu naḥ | svagā devebhya idaṃ namaḥ || iti 6 ucchuṣmo agne yajamānāyaidhi niśuṣmo abhidāsate iti 7 sruvāghāramāghāryamāṇamabhimantrayate mano'si prājāpatyam iti 8 vāgasyaindrī sapatnakṣayaṇī iti srucyam 9 4.12 pravarayoḥ pravriyamāṇayorjapati devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devā yo'hamasmi sa san yaje yasyāsmi na tamantaremi | svaṃ ma iṣṭam̐ svaṃ dattam̐ svaṃ pūrta m̐svam̐ śrāntam̐ svam̐ hutam | tasya me'gnirupadra ṣṭā vāyurupaśrotādityo'nukhyātā dyauḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā prajāpatirbandhuḥ | ya evāsmi sa san yaje yasyāsmi na tamantaremi iti 1 prayājānāmiṣṭamiṣṭamanumantrayate vasantamṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi ityetaiḥ pratimantram 2 eko mamaikā tasya yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || dvau mama dve tasya yo'smān dvevṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || trayo mama tisrastasya yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || catvāro mama catasrastasya yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || pañca mama na tasya kiṃcana yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || iti ca 3 ājyabhāgāviṣṭāvanumantrayate agninā yajñaścakṣuṣmām̐ stasyāhaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam ityāgneyam 4 4.13 somena yajñaścakṣuṣmām̐ stasyāhaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam iti saumyam 1 samastānumantraṇameke samāmananti agnīṣomayorahaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam iti 2 āgneyasya puroḍāśasya havirāhutimanumantrayate agnerahaṃ devayajyayānnādo bhūyāsam iti 3 dabdhirasyadabdho bhūyāsamamuṃ dabheyam ityupām̐ śuyājasya | yaṃ dveṣṭi tasya nāma gṛhṇāti 4 agnīṣomayorahaṃ devayajyayā vṛtrahā bhūyāsam ityagnīṣomīyasya 5 indrā gniyorahaṃ devayajyayendri yāvyannādo bhūyāsam ityaindrā gnasya 6 indra syāhaṃ devayajyayendri yāvī bhūyāsam iti sāṃnāyyayoḥ 7 mahendra syāhaṃ devayajyayā jemānaṃ mahimānaṃ gameyam iti yadi mahendra yājī bhavati 8 agneḥ sviṣṭakṛto'haṃ devayajyayāyuṣmān yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ | agnirmā duriṣṭāt pātu iti ca 9 indra sya vaimṛdhasyāhaṃ devayajyayāsapatno bhūyāsam iti vaimṛdhasya 10 4.14 iḍāmāhviyamāṇāmabhimantrayate surūpavarṣavarṇa ehi iti pratipadya upahūta upahavaṃ te'śīya ityantena 1 upām̐ śūpahave sapta devagavīrjapati bhūyasyehi śreyasyehi vasīyasyehi citta ehi dadhiṣa ehīḍa ehi sūnṛta ehi iti 2 uccairupahave sapta manuṣyagavīḥ cidasi manāsi vasvī rantī ramatiḥ sūnuḥ sūnarā devīrdevairabhi mā nivartadhvam | syonāḥ syonena ghṛtena mā samukṣata | na ma idamupadambhiṣagṛṣirbrahmā yaddade samudrā dudacanniva srucā | vāgagre viprasya tiṣṭhati śṛṅgebhirdaśabhirdiśan || iti ca 3 yarhi hoteḍāmupahvayeta tarhi yajamāno hotāramīkṣamāṇo vāyuṃ manasā dhyāyet vāyuriḍāyā vatsaḥ sā me vāyunā vatsena śraddhāṃ tapaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ dhukṣva iti 4 upahūyamānāyāṃ japati sā me satyāśīḥ iti pratipadya juṣṭiṃ te gameyam ityantena 5 upahūtāmanumantrayate iḍāyā ahaṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimān paśumān bhūyāsam iti 6 bhakṣāyāhviyamāṇāmabhimantrayate iḍā dhenuḥ sahavatsā na āgādūrjaṃ duhānā payasā prapīnā | sā no annena haviṣota gobhiriḍābhyasmām̐ āgāt || iti 7 4.15 vyākhyātā mārjanī 1 barhiṣadaṃ puroḍāśamabhimṛśati bradhna pinvasva dadato me mā kṣāyi kurvato me mopa dasat | diśāṃ kḷptirasi | diśo me kalpantāṃ kalpantāṃ me diśo daivīśca mānuṣīśca | ahorātre me kalpetām | ardhamāsā me kalpantām | māsā me kalpantām | ṛtavo me kalpantām | saṃvatsaro me kalpatām | kḷptirasi kalpatāṃ me || āśānāṃ tvāśāpālebhyaścaturbhyo amṛtebhyaḥ | idaṃ bhūtasyādhyakṣebhyo vidhema haviṣā vayam || bhajatāṃ bhāgī bhāgaṃ mā bhāgo bhakta nirabhāgaṃ bhajāmaḥ | apaspinvauṣadhīrjinva | dvipāt pāhi catuṣpādava | divo vṛṣṭimeraya || brāhmaṇānāmidam̐ haviḥ somyānām̐ somapīthinām | nirbhakto'brāhmaṇo nehābrāhmaṇasyāsti || iti 2 antarvedyanvāhāryamāsannamabhimṛśati iyam̐ sthālyamṛtasya pūrṇā sahasradhāra utso akṣīyamāṇaḥ | sa dādhāra pṛviī!mantarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca tenaudanenātitarāṇi mṛtyum || iti | prajāpaterbhāgo'si iti cānuvākaśeṣeṇa 3 etenaiva brahmābhimṛśati 4 4.16 anūyājasamidhamādhīyamānāmabhimantrayate eṣā te agne samit tayā vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva | vardhatāṃ ca te yajñapatirā ca pyāyatām | vardhiṣīmahi ca vayamā ca pyāsiṣīmahi iti 1 āhitāyāmāhavanīyam yaṃ te agna āvṛścāmyahaṃ vā kṣipitaścaran | prajāṃ ca tasya mūlaṃ ca nīcairdevā nivṛścata || agne yo no'bhidāsati samāno yaśca niṣṭyaḥ | idhmasyeva prakṣāyato mā tasyoccheṣi kiṃcana || yo māṃ dveṣṭi jātavedo yaṃ cāhaṃ dveṣmi yaśca mām | sarvā m̐stānagne saṃdaha yām̐ ścāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām || iti 2 idhmasaṃnahanam̐ hutamanumantrayate vedirbarhiḥ śritam̐ haviridhmaḥ paridhayaḥ srucaḥ | ājyaṃ yajña ṛco yajuryājyāśca vaṣaṭkārāḥ | saṃ me saṃnatayo namantāmidhmasaṃnahane hute || iti 3 anūyājānāmiṣṭamiṣṭamanumantrayate barhiṣo'haṃ devayajyayā prajāvān bhūyāsam ityetaiḥ pratimantram 4 srucau vyūhyamāne vājavatībhyāmabhimantrayate vājasya mā prasavena iti dvābhyām 5 paridhīnajyamānānabhimantrayate vasūn devān yajñenāpiprem | rudrā n devān yajñenāpiprem | ādityān devān yajñenāpiprem iti 6 4.17 prastaramajyamānamabhimantrayate samaṅktāṃ barhirhaviṣā ghṛtena samādityairvasubhiḥ saṃ marudbhiḥ | samindre ṇa viśvebhirdevebhiraṅktāṃ divyaṃ nabho gacchatu yat svāhā || iti 1 yatrābhijānāti agniridam̐ havirajuṣata iti tannigadāṃnigadāṃ devatāmanumantrayate agnerahamujjitimanūjjeṣam ityetairmantrairyathādevatam 2 yarhi hotā yajamānasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt tarhi brūyāt emā agmannāśiṣo dohakāmāḥ iti 3 purastādapāttaṃ tṛṇamanuprahviyamāṇamanumantrayate divaḥ khīlo'vatataḥ pṛthivyā adhyutthitaḥ | tenā sahasrakāṇḍena dviṣantam̐ śocayāmasi | dviṣanme bahu śocatvoṣadhe mo aham̐ śucam || iti 4 paridhiṣu
